messages:
tess: Heads-up, I hit two related issues while updating the 429/timeouts troubleshooting section:

1) examples only check Retry-After header; some infra returns retry_after in JSON body.
2) our context-trim example (Python) demonstrates naive truncation that can break structured outputs (JSON responses) if prompt trimming cuts in the middle of an open object.

rahul: Oof. Can you paste the problematic snippets?

tess: ```python
# old 429 example (docs/error-ref/retry.md)
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status == 429:
    wait = int(resp.headers.get("Retry-After"))
    time.sleep(wait)
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
```

```python
# old context-trim example (docs/guides/context_trim.md)
def trim_prompt(prompt, max_tokens):
    while token_count(prompt) > max_tokens:
        prompt = prompt[1:]
    return prompt
```

zane: The context trimming is especially bad for JSON outputs. We should recommend token-aware trimming that preserves last complete instruction block, and provide an escape hatch for structured output (system messages + response schema).

eng-runtime: Confirming the 429 variance: older proxy returns {"retry_after": N} in body, new ones set Retry-After header. We'll add a consistent metadata field response.retry_in_seconds in the next deploy (ETA Tue). Filed ENG-RUNTIME-1308.

rahul: Proposed doc PR changes:
- Update retry example to prefer response.retry_in_seconds (when available), then fall back to header, then body.
- Add JS, Go, and Ruby snippets showing robust handling + backoff with jitter.
- Replace naive trim with token-aware preserve-json utility and add a small snippet showing how to keep system instructions intact.
- Add a short note in migration guide about "proxy behavior and retry semantics".

tess: Also add a test harness: scripts/mock_429 with curlable endpoints that return header/body variants; CI should run the docs smoke tests against it.

qa-bot: QA checklist: add unit tests for header/body/backoff logic, integration smoke with mock_429, and manual check for context-trim example against a sample JSON schema.

rahul: I'll own the docs PR. Branch: docs/retry-backoff-context-fix. I will include a simple docker-compose mock and a Makefile target make docs-smoke.

zane: For the trim util, please include both a simple greedy token trim and a safe schema-aware approach. Show a tiny JS helper for detecting incomplete JSON and trimming to last valid object boundary.

eng-runtime: We'll try to ship the response.retry_in_seconds field before your PR lands; if not present, your fallback logic will cover both cases. Also adding a server-side header for X-Context-Limit on the response so docs can reference it.

rahul: Good. docs-bot: please remember to add docs label, link to ENG-RUNTIME-1308, and use docs-pr-template.md.

docs-bot: Reminder: attach 'docs' label, add changelog entry under "runtime" and include a short migration note. Use PR template.

tess: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3120 

rahul: Pushed tests and mock. @zane please eyeball the trim utility.

zane: Reviewing now. Will add a tiny test for JSON truncation.

tess: Thanks team. Once merged, QA will run make docs-smoke and we'll schedule a quick canary check on staging. :thumbsup:
